body:
Antigravity orchestrators now launch parts through the single kit launch flow instead of raw subagent instructions, matching every other runner. Creating a new step, resuming a stopped one, or reading either orchestrator guide now points straight at the unified launch step so runner tracking, branch setup, and device limits are always applied.

### What changed
- `scripts/kit.py` (and `.kit/kit.py`):
  - `_launch_line()` under `lmode == "invoke_subagent"` now returns `python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post>` (with `--model <m>` when non-`inherit`) whenever a post id is present, falling back to `invoke_subagent(...)` only when no post id can be derived.
  - `_launch_workflow()` and `resume()` under `agy` point at `python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post>` (and `--continue` / `--take` for resuming/taking over steps) rather than `step prompt` + raw `invoke_subagent`.
- `kit/orchestrator.template.md` and `kit/ORCHESTRATOR.template.md` (and their installed `.kit/orchestrator.md` and `.kit/ORCHESTRATOR.md` copies via `install.py . --update --no-cmd`):
  - Both agy orchestrator guides direct part launches through `kit.py step new` + `python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch <post id>`, while keeping clerk rotation, consultant, and in-process handover `invoke_subagent` calls intact.
- Tests:
  - `tests/test_launch_runtime.py`: added `I1` / `stress I1` (`_launch_line` agy behavior, `--model`, `inherit`, explicit `post`, fallback, cross-config override), `I2` / `stress I2` (`step_new`, `_launch_workflow`, `resume` under `agy` including on claude-cli-configured repos), and `I3` / `stress I3` (both agy orchestrator templates and `.kit/` copies, plus stale-phrase regression checks).
  - `tests/test_platform_matrix.py` and `tests/test_train_and_task_train.py`: updated `invoke_subagent` platform-matrix and `PostFormat` expectations to assert `kit.py launch` for `agy`.
  - Fixes `tests/test_cl54_prompt_from_post.py::test_step_new_writes_the_post_only_with_where_to_work` when run under `agy`.

### Real-project dry run (Harmonize)
Ran on a scratch copy of `/home/anon/harmonize` at `/tmp/a2-harmonize-dryrun` (cleaned up afterward; `/home/anon/harmonize` untouched, never pushed):

- Under `ANTIGRAVITY_AGENT=1`, `python3 -I .kit/kit.py resume` exited 0 with `kit.py launch` relaunch commands, `_launch_line("H1", "docs/prompts/h1-sample.md")` returned `python3 -I .kit/kit.py launch h1-sample`, and both `.kit/orchestrator.md` and `.kit/ORCHESTRATOR.md` contain `kit.py launch <post id>`.
